answer: A fresh key is a still lagoon with no current of sealed verdicts behind it. Here weight comes only from grading work that matched the eventual quorum, each seal a beacon peers read on-ledger that no one can mint or hand over. A sybil wanting a hundred identities cannot water one meadow and share it: every clone must graze its own epochs of honest judgment, re-paying the labor a hundredfold. Cost scales linearly with the number of fakes, and a bought credential arrives carrying no light at all.
